resolution.question: Will at least two-thirds of the 21-member Interchange Format Working Group return ballots on draft revision 4 by the close of the comment period?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that at least 14 distinct members (two-thirds of 21) actually submitted a ballot (by any means accepted by the group) before 2026-09-15T23:59:00+00:00. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
